name: task-bridge
description: Export bounded repository work to ChatGPT and safely stage returned results for local validation and review.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded coding work to ChatGPT and safely re-import it
interface.longDescription: Package the exact repository context for a bounded work unit into one Task Capsule, then inspect, drift-check, stage, and locally validate a Result Capsule returned from ChatGPT without directly mutating the active worktree.
defaultPrompt: Export this bounded task to ChatGPT
Import this ChatGPT Result Capsule and review it
